title: Model comparison
flawed_if: TSB (medium bin) or XGBoost+MA3 (long bin) scores L vs MA3 in a majority of the testable blocks of its served bin; or SBA alpha=0.1 or naive scores W vs MA3 in a majority of testable blocks (ALL cohort)
checks_that_stop_the_build: G1: recomputed block verdicts and n_better/n_worse equal experiment_log.csv run block_tests_tierA exactly; G3: preds_plus actuals equal the extracted real series on every row

title: History truncation
flawed_if: For TSB (cutoff 12) or XGBoost+MA3 (cutoff 24): some k below the cutoff scores W vs MA3 in a majority of testable blocks (cutoff too high), or some k at or above the cutoff scores L vs MA3 in a majority of testable blocks (cutoff too low). MA3 WAPE is k-invariant for k >= 3 by construction.
checks_that_stop_the_build: G4: the harness with no truncation reproduces the stored tsb and xgb_abs@A forecasts exactly

title: MA3 window
flawed_if: MA2, MA6 or MA12 scores W vs MA3 on the full window AND in a majority of testable blocks (ALL cohort)

title: XGBoost+MA3 blend weight
flawed_if: Some blend weight w != 0.5 scores W vs w = 0.5 in a majority of testable long-bin blocks
checks_that_stop_the_build: G2: w = 0.5 equals ens_xgb_ma3@A and w = 0 equals ma3 (max abs diff < 1e-9)

title: Target transforms
flawed_if: Chance level = 2.5% per testable block (one tail of the 95% interval). FLAWED if real wins > 0, or the Clopper-Pearson 95% lower bound of the observed block-win rate > 2.5%
checks_that_stop_the_build: G8: 162 = 50 + 35 + 77 reconstructs from results_by_bin.csv and matches the SUMMARY tables

title: Unfit SKUs
flawed_if: The list does not reproduce (25 common-window SKUs with MASE >= 1.1 plus 3 fallback-source SKUs = 28), or the month record disagrees with the fit review (spikes 132/132, level ratio 86/86)

title: ABC Pareto
flawed_if: No decision threshold on record: descriptive only
checks_that_stop_the_build: G6: Unilever single 2026-02 gives 132 Tier A SKUs at 79.96% cumulative revenue share (DEC-22)

title: Allocation 103/105/108
flawed_if: The default 105% leaves month-end cover below 3 weeks (lp_inputs target_weeks), or leaves a shortfall that 108% clears

title: LP weights
flawed_if: At any grid point within +/-0.10 of (0.45, 0.35, 0.20) on every weight, the cut-SKU set (short > 0 at 103%) differs from the default's
checks_that_stop_the_build: G7: the harness at the default weights and 103% equals run_lp --dry-run 103% row for row

title: Service level
flawed_if: Stockout months are labelled model-implied (normal assumption). FLAWED if the measured monthly exceedance (actual > forecast + 1.28 sigma) has a 95% interval entirely above 10% (Z = 1.28 <-> 90%; analytics/optimization/lp.py:14)

title: Month-of-year index
flawed_if: Flag 'aggregate caveat needed' if the monthly index correlates positively (Spearman, p < 0.05) in every pair of full years 2023-2025 for a principal. Cannot overturn the SKU-level no-seasonal-model decision

title: Coverage map
flawed_if: none (descriptive; synthetic labelled). PLAN ONLY until etl_coverage (migration 0033) is in public
